verdicts.reason: Both are nearly the same broken leaderboard. The logo is jammed against the left edge, and the three fare cards are shrunk until the city names and 'from' labels can't be read. The cards are also split apart, with the headline wedged between Marrakech and Reykjavik, so the row of offers no longer reads as one group, and the subline is tiny next to the CTA. A keeps all three cards the same size. B makes the Reykjavik card wider and taller than the other two, which adds an inconsistency, so A is slightly less bad.
